scope: consumer UI and isolated fixtures, not backend or live LLM
checks: Compact task list begins near navigation; Deadlines switches Gantt/calendar and remembers the view without writing task data
Executor edits directly from the row in one dialog, preserving task identity and workflow
Lost single-field ACK exposes receipt recovery; cancel cannot discard an unknown result and no duplicate effect is sent
Profile avatar opens account context; signout is inside the menu, not permanent navigation
Guarded context switch uses distinct stores and canonical project IDs; new data never leaks into the previous project
One note action creates, saves and immediately opens inline editing; Ctrl+Enter saves and Escape preserves the prior text
Shape Enter edits its content directly without opening a properties panel
Linked task opens the existing full document on the map, without a board detour or duplicate task
Visible map search finds text and selects the canonical map object
Functional step Enter opens its editor directly; navigation protects its draft, save persists, and configuration never runs automation
Profile stays available on narrow screens; shared navigation and map fit dark responsive layouts
